take: Hidden Links Society sells thirty products and is documenting a hundred golf courses. That ratio is the most interesting thing about them, and it is the reason they are in here.
story_extra: On the surface this is another small-batch golf brand doing rope caps and chenille patches. The catalogue is good — the brass has real weight to it, the overshirt is heavier than it needs to be, the headcovers are made in Oregon — but it is not, by itself, unusual. What is unusual is what they are doing alongside it.
